|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-L-Theyre_Tracking_Us_(V)-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-theyretrackingusv022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/theyretrackingus.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•They’re Tracking Us”. Text: “Cancel Program Trap; droid it was deployed on may be taken into owner's hand. [Immune to Sense.] OR Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[They're Tracking Us (V) (Errata)]]): Errata-sheet slip, Errata Sheet 2021 Summer (official text as of 23 June 2021)<ref name="sheet-2021-06-22">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_062321.pdf Errata Sheet 2021 Summer] (Players Committee), page 1; PDF built 22 June 2021. Listed on the PC's [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips page] (Internet Archive, 20 September 2024).</ref> — the cut-out slip the PC published for sleeving over the card (an errata-sheet slip is its own version, separate from the PC card image of the same errata; Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed:''' the card type “Used Interrupt” became “Used or Lost Interrupt”; “Cancel Program Trap; droid it was deployed on may be taken into owner's hand. [Immune to Sense.] OR Add or” → “USED: Add or”; “1 Force.” → “1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. [Immune to Sense.]”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•They’re Tracking Us” → “They’re Tracking Us” (uniqueness dot removed); this version is the errata-sheet slip (a different printing from the card image before it). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “They’re Tracking Us”. Text: “USED: Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor. [Immune to Sense.]”

Text: “USED: Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. OR Activate 1 Force. LOST: Cancel Close Call, Gravity Shadow, Overwhelmed, or They've Shut Down The Main Reactor.
